name: Hallowed Rune
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the priest trainer Branstock. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
narrative.objectives: Read the Hallowed Rune and speak to Branstock Khalder in Anvilmar.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I'm the one who can train ya as you start to find your way around Coldridge Valley. When ya feel yer ready, come back to me and we'll see about maybe teaching you a new spell or two to fend off the valley from them blasted troggs.

Ya got the Light on yer side, along with all of Ironforge, adventurer... no pressure on ya to become somethin' special.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Ach! Ya made it, adventurer! Wonderful!

I was gonna say, I was about to lose faith that ye'd arrive at all... get it, lose faith? It's a joke, lass... aww, nevermind. Ya didn't come here for me bad jokes anyway.
